name: eno
description: Frontend architecture analyzer that scores tech stack, component design, build config, monorepo and OpenHarmony or VSCode extension layout, and outputs graded refactoring reports.

displayDescription.en: Analyzes frontend project architecture, evaluates tech stack choices, reviews component design patterns, audits build configuration, assesses monorepo workspace structure, and reviews OpenHarmony or VSCode extension layout, delivering structured scored reports with quantified grades, identified strengths, weaknesses, and prioritized actionable refactoring guidance.
displayDescription.zh: 深度分析前端项目架构、技术栈选型、组件设计与构建配置，输出含评分等级、优势短板和重构优先级的结构化评审报告。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze the architecture of my current frontend project and give me a scored review report.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析当前项目的前端架构并给出评分报告

quickPrompts.en: Analyze the architecture of my current frontend project and give me a scored review report.

quickPrompts.zh: 评审我的技术栈选型与组件设计

quickPrompts.en: Audit my build configuration and suggest optimizations.
